case_title: GOPAL & ANR. v. STATE OF RAJASTHAN
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under s. 302 rlw s. 34 IPC, sentenced to life imprisonment
neutral_facts: The prosecution case was that a fight between two rival groups resulted in the deaths of two persons. The accused party inflicted fatal injuries on the victims using lathi blows. There were six accused persons involved. The prosecution relied heavily on the evidence of injured eyewitnesses and the son of one of the victims. The trial court convicted the accused under Section 302 read with Section 34 of the IPC and sentenced them to life imprisonment. The High Court confirmed the conviction and sentence. The accused claimed they were defending themselves against an attack, but the court found that they exceeded their right of private defence when they chased and inflicted fatal injuries on the second victim after the initial attack had ended.
